spans.s:
Āhvāyaka : m. (pl.): A class of degraded Brāhmaṇas.

They are among the five who were condemned as Caṇḍālas among the Brāhmaṇas (āhvāyakā devalakā nakṣatragrāmayājakāḥ/ ete brāhmaṇacaṇḍālā mahāpathikapañcamāḥ) 12. 77. 8; if the royal treasury became empty, a king should collect taxes from them (etebhyo balim ādadyād dhīnakośo mahīpatiḥ) 12. 77. 9; (They are probably those who announced names in courts or executed court summons (?); Nī. on Bom.

: āhvāyakāḥ dharmādhikārīṇaḥ).
